source: Claude Haiku 5.5 via the Anthropic API, compiled from the 14 ContractNLI hypothesis texts only (no excerpts, no labels), 2026-11-14

questions.name: addresses_disclosure_of_agreement_existence
questions.question: Does the excerpt address disclosing the fact that the agreement was agreed or negotiated?

questions.name: prohibits_disclosing_agreement_existence
questions.question: Does the excerpt prohibit the Receiving Party from disclosing that the agreement was agreed or negotiated?

questions.name: requires_explicit_identification
questions.question: Does the excerpt require the Disclosing Party to expressly identify Confidential Information?

questions.name: applies_to_all_confidential_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt apply this identification requirement to all Confidential Information rather than only some?

questions.name: verbal_information_can_be_confidential
questions.question: Does the excerpt state that verbally conveyed information can be Confidential Information?

questions.name: excludes_verbal_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt exclude verbally conveyed information from Confidential Information?

programs.formula: restricts_use_of_confidential_information AND use_limited_to_stated_purposes AND NOT permits_use_for_other_purposes

questions.name: restricts_use_of_confidential_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt restrict how the Receiving Party may use Confidential Information?

questions.name: use_limited_to_stated_purposes
questions.question: Does the excerpt limit use of Confidential Information to the purposes stated in the agreement?

questions.name: permits_use_for_other_purposes
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to use Confidential Information for other purposes?

questions.name: states_no_rights_granted
questions.question: Does the excerpt state that the agreement grants the Receiving Party no license or right to Confidential Information?

questions.name: grants_rights_to_confidential_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt grant the Receiving Party a license or right to Confidential Information?

questions.name: addresses_compelled_disclosure
questions.question: Does the excerpt address disclosure of Confidential Information required by law, regulation or judicial process?

questions.name: requires_notice_to_disclosing_party
questions.question: Does the excerpt require the Receiving Party to notify the Disclosing Party when it must disclose Confidential Information under legal compulsion?

questions.name: addresses_acquiring_similar_information_from_third_party
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party acquiring information similar to Confidential Information from a third party?

questions.name: permits_acquiring_similar_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to acquire such similar information from a third party?

questions.name: restricts_acquiring_similar_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt restrict the Receiving Party from acquiring such similar information from a third party?

questions.name: addresses_copying_confidential_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party making copies of Confidential Information?

questions.name: permits_some_copies
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to make copies of some Confidential Information in some circumstances?

questions.name: prohibits_all_copying
questions.question: Does the excerpt prohibit all copying of Confidential Information?

questions.name: addresses_independent_development
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party independently developing information similar to Confidential Information?

questions.name: permits_independent_development
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to independently develop information similar to Confidential Information?

questions.name: addresses_retention_after_return_or_destruction
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party keeping Confidential Information after it is returned or destroyed?

questions.name: permits_some_retention
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to retain some Confidential Information after it is returned or destroyed?

questions.name: requires_complete_return_or_destruction
questions.question: Does the excerpt require return or destruction of all Confidential Information with no exceptions?

questions.name: addresses_return_or_destruction_on_termination
questions.question: Does the excerpt address return or destruction of Confidential Information upon termination of the agreement?

questions.name: requires_return_or_destruction_of_some_information
questions.question: Does the excerpt require the Receiving Party to destroy or return some Confidential Information upon termination of the agreement?

programs.formula: addresses_sharing_with_employees AND permits_sharing_with_some_employees AND NOT prohibits_all_employee_sharing

questions.name: addresses_sharing_with_employees
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party sharing Confidential Information with its employees?

questions.name: permits_sharing_with_some_employees
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to share some Confidential Information with some of its employees?

questions.name: prohibits_all_employee_sharing
questions.question: Does the excerpt prohibit the Receiving Party from sharing any Confidential Information with its employees?

programs.formula: addresses_sharing_with_third_parties AND permits_sharing_with_some_third_parties AND NOT prohibits_all_third_party_sharing

questions.name: addresses_sharing_with_third_parties
questions.question: Does the excerpt address the Receiving Party sharing Confidential Information with third parties?

questions.name: permits_sharing_with_some_third_parties
questions.question: Does the excerpt permit the Receiving Party to share some Confidential Information with some third parties such as consultants, agents or professional advisors?

questions.name: prohibits_all_third_party_sharing
questions.question: Does the excerpt prohibit the Receiving Party from sharing any Confidential Information with third parties?

programs.formula: addresses_survival_after_termination AND some_obligations_survive_termination AND NOT all_obligations_end_on_termination

questions.name: addresses_survival_after_termination
questions.question: Does the excerpt address whether any obligations continue after the agreement terminates?

questions.name: some_obligations_survive_termination
questions.question: Does the excerpt state that some obligations under the agreement survive its termination?

questions.name: all_obligations_end_on_termination
questions.question: Does the excerpt state that all obligations under the agreement end when it terminates?
